title: Algebra 1
description: A comprehensive first-year algebra course aligned with Florida standards, covering linear equations, quadratic functions, exponential relationships, and data analysis. Designed for NCAA core mathematics credit.
subject: math
syllabus: Algebra 1 develops mathematical proficiency in solving linear equations, graphing functions, working with polynomials, and analyzing data. Students will engage with real-world applications and develop problem-solving skills essential for higher mathematics.
pacing_guide:
Weeks 1-9: Linear equations and inequalities
Weeks 10-18: Systems of equations and functions
Weeks 19-27: Quadratic equations and functions
Weeks 28-36: Exponential functions and data analysis
teacher_notes: Weekly teacher check-ins required for graded assignments. Monitor student progress on weekly quizzes. Provide feedback on written problem-solving explanations.
academic_integrity_policy: All tests and quizzes must be completed independently. Collaboration is encouraged on practice problems. Midterm and final exams require proctoring.

weeks.title: Introduction to Algebra and Variables
weeks.description: Students will learn the basics of algebraic notation, variables, expressions, and order of operations.
objectives: Translate word problems into algebraic expressions
weeks.teacher_interaction_notes: Review student homework submissions. Provide feedback on expression translations.

lesson_plans.title: Variables and Expressions
lesson_plans.description: Introduction to algebraic variables and writing expressions

reading_resource.title: OpenStax Algebra Ch. 1.1: Variables and Expressions

lesson_plans.guided_notes: Define variables. Practice writing expressions from word problems.
lesson_plans.practice_activity: Complete 20 practice problems on variable expressions

lesson_plans.title: Order of Operations (PEMDAS)
lesson_plans.description: Review and practice order of operations

reading_resource.title: OpenStax Algebra Ch. 1.2: Order of Operations

lesson_plans.practice_activity: Solve 25 expressions using correct order of operations

lesson_plans.title: Evaluating Expressions
lesson_plans.description: Substitute values and evaluate algebraic expressions

lesson_plans.title: Simplifying Expressions
lesson_plans.description: Combine like terms and simplify expressions

lesson_plans.title: Week 1 Review and Quiz
lesson_plans.description: Review key concepts and take weekly quiz

assessments.title: Week 1 Quiz: Variables and Expressions
assessments.description: 15-question quiz covering variables, expressions, and order of operations

weeks.title: Solving One-Step Equations
weeks.description: Introduction to solving basic linear equations using addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.
objectives: Solve one-step equations using inverse operations
Model real-world situations with one-step equations

weeks.title: Midterm Review and Exam
weeks.description: Comprehensive review of Weeks 1-17 and midterm examination.
objectives: Demonstrate mastery of linear equations and inequalities
Show work and explain problem-solving strategies
weeks.teacher_interaction_notes: Proctor midterm exam. Review exams with students individually.

assessments.title: Semester 1 Midterm Exam
assessments.description: Comprehensive exam covering all material from Weeks 1-17
assessments.proctoring_requirements: Must be proctored by certified teacher or approved proctor. Photo ID required.

weeks.title: Final Exam and Course Wrap-Up
weeks.description: Final examination covering all course material and course reflection.
objectives: Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of Algebra 1 concepts
weeks.teacher_interaction_notes: Proctor final exam. Provide final grade feedback and recommendations for next math course.

assessments.title: Algebra 1 Final Exam
assessments.description: Comprehensive final examination covering all course content
assessments.proctoring_requirements: Must be proctored by certified teacher or approved proctor. Photo ID required.
